note: Trigger eval. Half of these must load the skill, half must not. A pack that fires on every question is a pack the user turns off. Execute with evals/run.sh, never read as prose.

cases.query: the login endpoint 500s on an empty body, fix it
cases.why: a named defect with a reproducible symptom - the spine applies end to end

cases.query: поправь баг в экспорте, тесты падают
cases.why: same request in Russian: a failing test is a RED step waiting to happen

cases.query: add a CSV export button to the reports page
cases.why: new user-visible behaviour, needs owner, plan and proof

cases.query: this component re-renders on every keystroke, make it stop
cases.why: a measurable claim: RED is a measurement, not an opinion

cases.query: split UserService into something sane, behaviour must not change
cases.why: same behaviour, different shape - the suite must be green before and after

cases.query: review this diff before I merge it
cases.why: judging a diff is steps 1, 2, 9, 10 with a findings ledger

cases.query: the modal closes when you click inside it, no idea why
cases.why: lost, not yet fixing: reproduce first, then re-enter FIX

cases.query: bump the copyright year in the footer
cases.why: still needs a verdict and evidence, just the four-step floor

cases.query: dark mode toggle flashes white on load, fix the flash
cases.why: anything a user sees runs the UI guard

cases.query: our deploy script silently skips migrations, sort it out
cases.why: a silent wrong behaviour in code the team owns

cases.query: what is the difference between a mutex and a semaphore?
cases.why: a pure knowledge question - no repository, no diff, no done-test

cases.query: should we pick Postgres or DynamoDB for this product?
cases.why: design-only: nothing is being changed yet, so there is nothing to prove

cases.query: sketch an architecture for a multi-tenant billing service
cases.why: greenfield design talk; the protocol starts when a diff starts

cases.query: audit this repo for security holes
cases.why: a security audit belongs to viora-aegis, not to the change protocol

cases.query: is our JWT handling vulnerable to algorithm confusion?
cases.why: threat question, viora-aegis territory

cases.query: explain what this regex does
cases.why: reading, not changing - an explanation has no done-test

cases.query: write a commit message for the changes I already made
cases.why: prose about a finished diff, no gates to run

cases.query: what did we ship last sprint?
cases.why: project history, not engineering work

cases.query: recommend a book on distributed systems
cases.why: no code, no repository, no claim to prove

cases.query: pros and cons of trunk-based development for a team of six
cases.why: process advice; the pack would add ceremony and produce nothing checkable
